definitions.explanation: a person who organizes or manages an event or group; a caretaker; a sponsor

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}が{今回|こんかい}の{世話人|せわにん}だ。
examples.english: She is the organizer for this time.

examples.japanese: {世話人|せわにん}として{会|かい}を{取|と}りまとめる。
examples.english: To organize the meeting as the coordinator.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}の{世話人|せわにん}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: I was chosen as the organizer for the class reunion.

notes:
{世話人|せわにん} refers to someone who takes responsibility for organizing or managing something.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {世話|せわ}: Care, assistance, help
- {人|にん}: Person

FUNCTIONS:
- Event organizer: Arranges meetings, gatherings, reunions
- Group coordinator: Manages communications and logistics
- Sponsor/patron: Supports an event or cause
- Caretaker: In some contexts, someone who looks after others

USAGE:
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}の{世話人|せわにん} (class reunion organizer)
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}の{世話人|せわにん} (wedding coordinator/sponsor)
- {勉強会|べんきょうかい}の{世話人|せわにん} (study group organizer)
- {議員連盟|ぎいんれんめい}の{世話人|せわにん} (parliamentary group coordinator)

POLITICAL USAGE:
In politics, {世話人|せわにん} often refers to a coordinator of a parliamentary group or faction.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幹事|かんじ}: Secretary, organizer (more formal)
- {主催者|しゅさいしゃ}: Host, sponsor (more formal)
- {世話人|せわにん}: Emphasizes the caretaking/facilitating role

REGISTER: Neutral.
